name: PositionsChangeInformer
summary: This EA monitors trade transactions and raises alerts (popup, sound, or email) when positions are opened, closed, or reversed. It does not execute any trades itself; it functions purely as a notification utility for position change events.
summary_zh: 该EA监控交易事务，当持仓发生开仓、平仓或反转时，通过弹窗、声音或电子邮件发出通知。它本身不执行任何交易，纯粹是一个持仓变动通知工具。
strategy_analysis: 该EA并非交易策略EA，而是一个持仓变动通知工具。它通过OnTradeTransaction事件监听交易事务变化，当检测到TRADE_TRANSACTION_DEAL_ADD类型的事务时，获取最新成交记录并判断其类型。入场通知：当成交类型为DEAL_ENTRY_IN时，提示开仓信息包括价格、止损、止盈和手数。出场通知：当成交类型为DEAL_ENTRY_OUT时，提示平仓信息并判断是止损平仓、止盈平仓还是普通平仓，同时显示盈亏结果。反转通知：当成交类型为DEAL_ENTRY_INOUT时，提示反向操作信息。仓位管理和资金管理方面，该EA不涉及任何仓位或资金管理逻辑，因为它不执行交易操作。其核心功能是将持仓变动信息及时通知交易者，支持多语言翻译和多种告警方式。
strategy_analysis_en: This EA is not a trading strategy but a position change notification utility. It listens to trade transactions via the OnTradeTransaction event, and when a TRADE_TRANSACTION_DEAL_ADD transaction is detected, it retrieves the latest deal record and determines its type. Entry notification: When the deal entry is DEAL_ENTRY_IN, it reports opening information including price, stop loss, take profit, and volume. Exit notification: When the deal entry is DEAL_ENTRY_OUT, it reports closing information, distinguishes between stop loss closure, take profit closure, or normal closure, and displays the profit/loss result. Reversal notification: When the deal entry is DEAL_ENTRY_INOUT, it reports a reverse operation. Regarding position sizing and money management, this EA does not involve any position or money management logic since it does not execute trades. Its core function is to promptly notify traders of position changes, supporting multi-language translation and multiple alert methods including popup alerts, sound alerts, and email notifications.

parameters.name: InpAlertType
parameters.description: 告警类型：弹窗(ALERT)、声音(SOUND)或邮件(EMAIL)
parameters.description_en: Alert type: popup (ALERT), sound (SOUND), or email (EMAIL)

pros: 支持三种通知方式（弹窗、声音、邮件），灵活满足不同场景需求
自动识别平仓原因（止损/止盈/普通平仓），提供详细交易信息
集成多语言翻译系统，便于不同语言用户使用
通过OnTradeTransaction实时监控，响应及时无延迟
pros_en: Supports three notification methods (alert, sound, email) for flexible use across different scenarios
Automatically identifies close reason (stop loss / take profit / normal), providing detailed trade information
Integrated multi-language translation system for international user convenience
Uses OnTradeTransaction for real-time monitoring with no delay
cons: 仅通知成交信息，不提供挂单变动或持仓修改的通知
邮件发送失败时仅打印日志，没有降级为弹窗告警的备用机制
声音文件路径处理逻辑不够健壮，仅在MQL5终端文件目录下查找
代码中line 144使用了硬编码英文字符串"Other operation"而非通过翻译系统处理
cons_en: Only notifies on deal executions, missing pending order changes or position modifications
When email sending fails, it only logs the error without a fallback to alert notification
Sound file path handling is not robust enough, only searching within the MQL5 terminal files directory
Line 144 uses a hardcoded English string "Other operation" instead of going through the translation system
improvements: 增加对挂单变动和持仓修改的通知功能，使监控更全面
邮件发送失败时应自动降级为弹窗告警，确保通知不遗漏
improvements_en: Add notifications for pending order changes and position modifications for more comprehensive monitoring
Implement automatic fallback to alert notification when email sending fails to ensure no notifications are missed

risk_points: 该EA不执行任何交易操作，不存在交易风险
仅作为通知工具，对交易账户无直接影响
risk_points_en: This EA does not execute any trading operations, posing no trading risk
It functions solely as a notification tool with no direct impact on trading accounts
